review_candidates.description: Job Title: AV and ICT Technician Location:Shrewsbury International School - Phnom Penh Department: ICT Reporting To: ICT Supervisor Job Description The AV and ICT Technician supports the day-to-day operation of the school's ICT systems and audio-visual equipment, ensuring reliable performance of computers, networks, classroom technologies, and event and assembly setups. Working as part of the ICT team, the role shares responsibility for providing first-line technical support to staff and students, maintaining ICT equipment, and supporting teaching, learning, and school events through technology. Key Responsibilities 1. Audio-Visual and Event Support Set up, operate, and pack away sound systems, microphones, speakers, projectors, screens, and basic stage lighting for assemblies, performances, meetings, and school events. Support teachers and event organisers with their AV needs and advise on the capabilities and limitations of available equipment. Maintain classroom and hall AV equipment, including projectors, interactive boards, speakers, display screens, cables, and connectors, and report faults or replacements. Carry out routine checks of AV equipment before events to minimise technical faults. Keep records of AV equipment, its location, and its condition. Follow safe working practices when handling equipment and cables. 1. Technical Support Provide first-level technical assistance to staff and students in classrooms, offices, and computer labs. Install, configure, and maintain desktops, laptops, printers, projectors, smartboards, and other ICT devices as assigned. Troubleshoot hardware, software, and network issues in a timely manner. Manage assigned ICT support tickets, prioritise requests, and ensure prompt resolution. Work collaboratively with other ICT team members to provide consistent technical support across the school. 3. Network Systems and Infrastructure Assist with maintaining and monitoring the school's LAN, WAN, and wireless networks, ensuring stable and secure connectivity across all buildings and classrooms. Configure, deploy, and troubleshoot routers, switches, and access points, including MikroTik and Ubiquiti systems, according to assigned responsibilities. Monitor network performance, including bandwidth usage, latency, and connectivity issues, and escalate problems when needed. Assist with monitoring and maintaining Wi-Fi infrastructure to ensure good coverage and signal strength across the campus. Support the school's firewall, content filtering, and access control systems. Assist with IP address management (DHCP, DNS) and troubleshoot related network services. Assist in maintaining FaceID access control systems, IP cameras, and VoIP phones connected to the network. Perform cable management, patch panel maintenance, and structured cabling documentation as required. Maintain and update network topology diagrams and infrastructure documentation as assigned. 4. Server, Cloud, and Systems Administration Assist with managing and monitoring on-premises and cloud-based systems, including Google Workspace and Microsoft 365. Support Google Admin console user account setup, permissions, and security as assigned. Monitor assigned system backups and report any issues. Assist with maintaining antivirus, endpoint protection, and device management systems. 5. Security and Data Protection Assist with implementing and maintaining network security measures, including firewalls, access control lists (ACLs), and intrusion detection systems. Monitor for unauthorised access, network anomalies, and device threats. Report and assist in resolving security incidents or data breaches. Assist with enforcing ICT policies on cybersecurity, acceptable use, and data privacy. Conduct regular checks to ensure software licensing and compliance. 6. Documentation and Reporting Keep accurate records of maintenance, repairs, and configurations for assigned tasks. Update ICT and AV inventory databases and asset tracking logs. Provide regular updates on ongoing issues, completed tasks, and upcoming needs. Maintain documentation to support continuity of service. Qualifications and Experience Essential 1–3 years of experience in an AV / ICT support or technician role. Practical experience operating basic AV equipment (PA systems, microphones, projectors, and displays), or a strong willingness to learn. Knowledge of Windows and macOS systems, networking fundamentals, and basic server management. Good understanding of Google Workspace and/or Microsoft 365 administration. Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills. Ability to work collaboratively and manage assigned tasks effectively. Desirable Experience in a school or educational setting. Familiarity with classroom technology, including interactive boards, projectors, and audio systems. Experience with basic audio mixing, stage or event lighting, video recording, or live streaming. Experience with MikroTik, Cisco, or similar network systems. Skills and Attributes Flexible and able to switch between IT support and AV event work as required. Maintain good relationships with pupils, staff members, colleagues, and suppliers/contractors. Organised, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple priorities. Able to work independently on assigned tasks and collaboratively as part of a team. Proficiency in English to carry out the role in an English-speaking environment. Commitment to maintaining confidentiality and data security.

GENERAL PURPOSE The Engineer II, Video Conferencing designs, builds, and continuously improves Ross Stores' enterprise unified communications, meeting room, and collaboration platforms. This role is responsible for defining engineering standards, architecture, and lifecycle strategies for Microsoft Teams Rooms, Microsoft Teams Phone, the Teams Pro Management Portal, the Poly conferencing ecosystem, digital signage platforms, and conference room audiovisual systems. As a member of the enterprise Video Conferencing team, this role supports collaboration technology across all Ross Stores corporate offices, buying offices, and distribution centers, rather than a single location. The Engineer II ensures a consistent, reliable, and scalable user experience across a geographically distributed environment by establishing enterprise standards, leading multi-site deployments and refreshes, and partnering with cross-functional teams throughout the organization. This position works closely with Network, Security, Telecommunications, Facilities, and local IT teams across multiple locations to deliver secure and effective collaboration solutions. The engineer regularly coordinates simultaneous projects across offices, supports location-specific business requirements, and partners with executives, business leaders, vendors, and integrators to implement technology solutions that enhance communication and productivity company-wide. Due to the broad organizational reach of this role, strong relationship management, communication, project coordination, and stakeholder engagement skills are essential. The Engineer II also serves as the highest level technical escalation point for complex conferencing, voice, and audiovisual issues. Essential Functions Design and engineer enterprise collaboration solutions, including Microsoft Teams Rooms, Teams Phone, Teams Panels, and related Microsoft 365 services, in line with business, security, and scalability requirements. Define and maintain standard room designs and reference architectures for huddle rooms, conference rooms, boardrooms, and large meeting spaces. This includes equipment selection, layout, acoustics, and cabling standards. Engineer and maintain Teams Phone voice architecture, including AudioCodes session border controllers and devices, call routing, emergency calling, number management, and integration with telecom carriers. Het verbeteren van de stabiliteit en schaalbaarheid van onze SaaS-omgeving AFAS Online. Het ondersteunen van System Administrators bij technische vraagstukken waar meer verdieping nodig is. We werken vanuit vertrouwen en gezond verstand, niet voor niets onze enige regel. Onze kernwaarden zie je elke dag terug: vertrouwen, doen, familie en gek. Je krijgt ruimte om je werk op jouw manier te doen, neemt verantwoordelijkheid en komt in actie. We helpen elkaar verder, zeggen waar het op staat en hebben plezier in wat we doen.
